data.body: Triage (orphan sweep): RESOLVED — the described test failure no longer reproduces. Fixed on main by commit 81b3b5929423a641cbf9dbf806796599df01d59f ('shockproof-twill-porpoise: fix metric test'), which pins engine_b._METRIC_CANDIDATES to a missing tool at tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py:100 so the metric-backend skip is deterministic instead of depending on a locally-installed metric tool (the root cause), and strengthens the assertion. Verified now on main @9bdb22f5887: '.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py -q' -> 5 passed, with the AC5 table showing 'metric ran=0 skipped=1 reasons={no_tool: 1}'. The root-cause ticket 8322-6f05-ea1b-4da1 is closed; this ticket and its two siblings (0ba2, 354d, 78f4) all describe the same failure. Closing as duplicate of 8322-6f05-ea1b-4da1.
